title: Right / left 11-11 (DTW)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones). This experiment compares the full shape of each movement with Dynamic Time Warping (template matching), allowing movements done faster or slower. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: Template matching with DTW: 19/19 in leave-one-out (18-19/19 in every setting); unsupervised clustering on DTW distances fails (10/19)
method: Dynamic Time Warping between the events' angle curves (relative to the 3 s before each event): 1-nearest-neighbour template matching (leave-one-out) and hierarchical clustering
